description: Build, schedule, and grade courses for any subject with a Claude Code-powered workflow.
pre_install:
$launcher = @'
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
appDir = fso.GetParentFolderName(WScript.ScriptFullName)
shell.Environment("PROCESS")("SELFSEMESTER_HOME") = appDir & "\data"
shell.Run Chr(34) & appDir & "\selfsemester.exe" & Chr(34), 1, False
'@
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'SelfSemester.vbs') -Value $launcher -Encoding ASCII
notes: The Start Menu shortcut launches a wrapper that sets SELFSEMESTER_HOME to the persisted data folder. Course creation and grading require Claude Code; it is not bundled.
